description: This file contains unit tests for the gateway agent prompt functions, using Vitest testing framework. It tests various scenarios for building agent messages from conversation entries, including handling of empty histories, text extraction from content arrays, utilization of history context, prioritization of tool entries, and normalization of content bodies.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Builds a context string from conversation entries, current message, and a formatting function.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatContent
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text from a chat content array, ignoring non-text content such as images.

methods.name: buildAgentMessageFromConversationEntries
methods.description: Constructs the agent message string from conversation entries, considering history and content normalization.
